title: Rewinding the work-tape head
statement: For every pair of Boolean words $x,a$ and every natural number $i\le |x|$, for every natural number $j\le |a|$, the raw strip machine started in state $2$ on input $x$, with work tape containing $a$, work head at position $j-1$, and empty output, reaches state $3$ with work head at position $0$ and unchanged tape and output after $j+1$ steps.
